review_mode: Static read/hash/AST and saved-data canonical reconstruction only. No candidate import, model, qualifier or optimizer execution; RUN_ONCE absent.

source_selection.binding: Full original file/freeze/review hashes verified. Selected manifest checksum and fashion_backend source hash verified. Original and new schedule/profile construction source match exactly: linspace/flipped batches, clean .45, label2, zero noise, sequences empty/T, objective N, lr1e-5. No numerical model operation used for this review.

chronology_review: Supervisor stages hash-bound selected checkpoint in isolated shared root; SessionWriter acquires lease before concrete Fashion restoration, checks cursor2/no pending/full selected payload, writes READY.

Independent contender launches only after bound own-PID READY; must refuse before provider or allocation while holder waits. Supervisor verifies/reaps contender, checks holder still alive, then atomically publishes PID/freeze-bound permit.

Holder writes new model handoff under lease, explicitly closes, proves closed payload refusal, exits. Supervisor reaps and hash-verifies checkpoint/handoff before launch inference. No planned kill; failure cleanup only own active PIDs.

Inference only reads same-run handoff, restores actual backend, same root lease, publishes2 fragments then durable intent/cancelled. Explicit close before new adapter; cancelled/frontier/intent restores all refuse unchanged state/output. Full afterstate saved and compared to handoff.
cost_boundary: Historical model clock2 and prior attempt receipts are input history, not new Adam calls; prior training costs remain additional, not zero. New restore/list/hash/serialization/guard/output/refusal work included in measured process subtree, no nested double counting.

resources.scope: Full outer wait4 includes reaped workers and supervisor tail; outerprefix/unknown tail, prior/source/review additional. Largest RSS not concurrent sum. No automatic retries/cap increases.

scope_limits: Real concrete Fashion session loading/lease handoff and controlled partial cancellation only; zero fresh training, not a fullimage-success run or all-boundaries integration.
Explicit trusted selected checkpoint, not latest-root authority/global token ledger or external callback exactly-once.
Cooperative stable local root only; no hostile raw session/core/backend bypass protection, distributed lock, fork-FD lifetime, powerloss/directory fsync or production-owner authority.
Original platform/data/science holds and prior provenance correction unchanged.
execution_authorization: Source pass only; parent once-only admission required.
